value.name: abandons call to Devin
value.description: Asha decides not to dial Devin and puts the phone away instead.
evidence: Asha slid the phone back into her coat pocket without dialing
Calling Devin now would be asking him to say back to her what she had already decided not to be sure of

value.name: reviews written phone number
value.description: Asha looks again at the ballpoint number she wrote on the envelope, tying it to a memory from Monday at counsel table.
evidence: her eyes still on the ballpoint number she had written along the top margin of the envelope
She read it once more, against the minute in her head when she had stood up at counsel table on Monday

value.name: hides envelope in car door
value.description: She folds the envelope so the number is hidden and tucks it into the door pocket behind the ice scraper.
evidence: folded the envelope in half so the number was on the inside and tucked it into the door pocket behind the ice scraper

value.name: drives home instead of calling
value.description: Asha starts driving home, keeping both hands on the wheel while avoiding the call to Devin and shifting her focus to Whitfield.
evidence: she put the car in gear before the impulse could finish forming
She took the turn toward home with both hands on the wheel
the voicemail under Whitfield's name still queued and no longer the thing she was trying not to think about
she had stopped rehearsing what she would say to Devin and started, instead, rehearsing what she would say in Whitfield's office without him

value.name: rehearses Whitfield confrontation
value.description: As she drives, Asha mentally prepares what she will say to Whitfield in his office without Devin present.
evidence: she had stopped rehearsing what she would say to Devin and started, instead, rehearsing what she would say in Whitfield's office without him

value.name: opens Whitfield voicemail
value.description: At a red light, Asha pulls out her phone and opens Whitfield's voicemail to listen again.
evidence: At the next red light Asha pulled the phone back out of her coat pocket and thumbed the voicemail open

value.name: hears Whitfield's voicemail again
value.description: Whitfield's voicemail plays again, repeating the docket number and his request that she come by before seven.
evidence: Whitfield's voice came through the speaker the way it had the first two times—evenly paced, the docket number given without hesitation, the request that she stop by before seven
